description: Defines the TailLogCommand struct implementing a command-line tool command to tail the latest transcript lines from a shared store.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that fetches and prints the last 10 lines of transcripts from the shared store.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves the latest transcripts and prints the last 10 lines.
